sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is the first application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant was arrested on 29.04.2023 in connection with Crime No.265/2023 by Police Station-Ambah, District- Morena (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 302, 304,B,
498A, 34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

In brief case of the prosecution is that, on 13.04.2023 at 9:19 pm applicant-accused who is father-in-law of the deceased gave an information to Police Station Ambah that in the afternoon at 2 pm his daughter-in-law deceased aged about 24 years alongwith her two children had gone to the field.
At 3:30 pm Manoj Sakhwar informed that his daughter-in-law is lying on the field in unconscious state.

Thereafter he brought the deceased to home and thereafter he admitted the Rajveer Singh Sankhwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74891407/
1 deceased in Ambah Hospital where doctor declared the deceased dead.

sentences.text: On his information, merg 28/2023 was recorded.
Dead body panchnama was prepared.
At the time of preparation of dead body panchnama father and brother of deceased were present.
Thereafter postmortem was conducted.
In postmortem report, 11 injuries were found on her body.

As per postmortem report,
deceased died due to hemorrhage shock as a result of assault.
Merg was inquired.
During merg inquiry statements of maternal side of the deceased was recorded.
They alleged that husband and in-laws of the deceased used to harass her due to demand of dowry.
They used to demand buffaloes and gold chain as dowry.
On 13.04.2023 husband of the deceased did marpeet with her.
Offence punishable under Section 302 and 304 B of IPC was registered.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that the allegation against husband and in-laws has been levelled during merg enqiry.
There is no eye-witnesses.
Dying declaration of the deceased has not been recorded.
Applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and in statements recorded during merg inquiry nowhere witnesses have alleged that he did marpeet with the deceased.
Conclusion of trial will take its own time.
The applicant is in custody since 29.04.2023 and he is the permanent resident of District- Morena (M.P.).
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
Under these circumstances, learned counsel for the applicant prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Learned Panel Lawyer for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.

Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash surety of Rs.25,000/- alongwith a personal bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail with condition that if he remains absent during trial, the said cash security will stand forfeited automatically without notice to the applicant.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
A copy of this order be sent to the concerned trial Court for necessary compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE ojha Rajveer Singh Sankhwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74891407/
